elements.name: form_instructions
elements.html:
This additional form helps the admissions committee determine how your previous studies meet the specific admission requirements for MSc Data Science and Artificial Intelligence.

Complete the form as follows:

  1. Applicant details - enter your personal information as it appears in your application.
  2. Previous studies - provide information about the degree(s) relevant to your application.
  3. Relevant courses - review the listed prerequisite subjects and topics, then add the passed courses you want to use as evidence.
  4. Prerequisite coverage - indicate which of your relevant courses provide evidence for each prerequisite subject.
  5. Report generation - generate and review the PDF report.

Complete all sections in English. If an official English translation of your academic documents was submitted with your application, use that version when completing this form. Before you begin, have your transcript(s) and official course descriptions ready. The form does not support intermediate saving, and your input may be lost if you close the browser.

After completing the form, generate and review the PDF report, then upload this PDF to OSIRIS. (Draft wording: to be confirmed.)

elements.description: Review the prerequisite subjects and topics before adding your relevant courses. For each of these subjects, you should provide evidence of about 5 EC EC refers to credits in the European Credit Transfer and Accumulation System (ECTS). 60 EC is one full-time academic year.
